name: spendbyteam
description: See what Claude Code costs per project, model, branch or day from your local session logs, and attribute your team's spend to git branches and tickets on SpendByTeam.

ingest_token.title: SpendByTeam ingest token (optional)
ingest_token.description: Write-only token (sbt_ing_...) from the SpendByTeam panel. Leave empty if you ran `npx spendbyteam connect`: the hook then reads ~/.spendbyteam/config.json. Without either, the hook sends nothing.
